title: Inventory Value for a date before release keeps its saved figures
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a tracked part from before this release, part A, at the test location, that has held 5 in bin location A and -2 in bin location B at a cost of $10.00 since before date A, with no change since, so the net of its bins is 3.
  • Use date A, a date before this release that the Inventory Value report has saved figures for.
  • Start on the Inventory Value report (Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value), with the as-of date on today.
custom_steps:
1. Pick the test location only in the Location filter.
  2. Set the as-of date to date A.
  3. Type part A's part number in the report's Search box.
  4. Set the as-of date to today.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report shows the test location only.

Step 2:

  • The report shows date A.

Step 3:

  • For date A, part A shows the figures saved before the release: Qty 5.00 and Total Cost $50.00 (5 × $10.00), the positive bin location A only, as the report counted them then.
  • The release did not rework that date to the net figure.

Step 4:

  • For today, part A shows Qty 3.00 and Total Cost $30.00 (5 + (-2) = 3; 3 × $10.00): dates from release on count the bin below zero.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, bug SV-10380 (Inventory Value report ignores negative bins and overstates net inventory value; ships with this epic)

  • Feature Overview, Accounting: “Inventory Value figures already saved for past dates keep their saved values. The count of bins below zero, which ships with this release, applies from release on and does not rework earlier dates.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10380, description, Acceptance criteria: “Inventory Value figures saved for dates before release keep their saved values. Only dates from release on count bins below zero.”
  • SV-10380, description, Acceptance criteria: “Existing historical snapshots captured with positive-only quantities are explicitly addressed; changing the live calculation must not be described as repairing old captured values automatically.”
  • SV-10380, description, Reproduction table: “+5 and -2 | 5 / $50 | 3 / $30”
